claims: Brad Underwood is the head men's basketball coach at the University of Illinois.
Brad Underwood has held the position of head men's basketball coach at the University of Illinois since March 2017.
Brad Underwood has led the Fighting Illini to multiple NCAA Tournament appearances.
Brad Underwood has led the Fighting Illini to a 2026 Final Four run.

The video is from March Madness YouTube.
Brad Underwood's position is Richmond Family Endowed Men's Head Basketball Coach.
Brad Underwood has won over 68% of his games over a 12-year Division I career.
Brad Underwood led Illinois to 10 seasons of 20+ wins.
Brad Underwood served as head coach at Oklahoma State.
Brad Underwood served as head coach at Stephen F. Austin.
Brad Underwood served as head coach in the junior college ranks.
